lines.text: Did you know? Vac is Latin for empty.
Vacancy: an empty room or job.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus empty?

words.ex: When the alarm sounds, evacuate the building by the nearest exit.
Sorry, we have no vacancies for the weekend of the festival.
Hotel guests must vacate their rooms by noon on the day of departure.
